narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multiple geopolitical flashpoints (Iran-US kinetic exchange, Israel multi-front war, Ukraine deep strikes) escalate simultaneously. The market consensus underestimates the persistence and breadth of these conflicts, driving flows into safe havens and commodities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long gold, short S&P 500 futures; overweight WTI crude oil calls as supply disruption risk is underpriced.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy assets as the Strait of Hormuz blockade persists through Q3 2026 per EIA, and SPR releases signal bullish supply tightness. The market misreads these as bearish, but actual flows show structural underinvestment and geopolitical risk driving oil higher.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI futures and energy sector ETFs; short refined product spreads as refinery margins compress.

narratives.title: Crypto as Macro Risk Proxy
narratives.summary: Bitcoin's selloff is macro-driven, not crypto-specific, as institutions de-risk amid geopolitical turmoil. However, whale accumulation and MicroStrategy buying suggest dip-buying, indicating capital sees crypto as a hedge against fiat debasement once risk-off peaks.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate Bitcoin via futures on dips below $60K; pair with short altcoins to isolate macro beta.
